title: Roman Dictator
quote: I came, I saw, I conquered.
note: Reported by Plutarch and Suetonius, on his victory at Zela, 47 BC.

title: Roman Dictator
quote: The die is cast.
note: Said crossing the Rubicon, per Suetonius.

title: King of Macedon
quote: I am indebted to my father for living, but to my teacher for living well.

title: King of Macedon
quote: If I were not Alexander, I would wish to be Diogenes.

title: Author of The Art of War
quote: The supreme art of war is to subdue the enemy without fighting.
note: The Art of War, Ch. 3 (Giles translation).

title: Author of The Art of War
quote: All warfare is based on deception.

title: Author of The Art of War
quote: Let your plans be dark and impenetrable as night, and when you move, fall like a thunderbolt.

title: Author of The Art of War
quote: The general who wins a battle makes many calculations in his temple before the battle is fought.

title: Carthaginian General
quote: We will either find a way, or make one.
note: Attributed regarding the crossing of the Alps, 218 BC.

title: Emperor of the French
quote: Victory belongs to the most persevering.

title: Emperor of the French
quote: History is a set of lies agreed upon.
note: Recorded by Las Cases, Memorial de Sainte-Helene.

title: Emperor of the French
quote: A soldier will fight long and hard for a bit of colored ribbon.

title: Founder of the Mongol Empire
quote: An action committed in anger is an action doomed to failure.
note: Attributed via the Mongol legal code, the Yassa.

title: U.S. Army General
quote: A good plan violently executed now is better than a perfect plan next week.

title: U.S. Army General
quote: Accept the challenges so that you can feel the exhilaration of victory.

title: U.S. Army General
quote: Courage is fear holding on a minute longer.

title: British Prime Minister
quote: We shall never surrender.

title: British Prime Minister
quote: This was their finest hour.

title: British Prime Minister
quote: Never in the field of human conflict was so much owed by so many to so few.
note: On the Battle of Britain, 20 August 1940.

title: British Prime Minister
quote: I have nothing to offer but blood, toil, tears and sweat.

title: King of Prussia
quote: A crown is merely a hat that lets the rain in.

title: King of Prussia
quote: Diplomacy without arms is like music without instruments.

title: Roman Emperor
quote: Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.

title: Roman Emperor
quote: You have power over your mind, not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.

title: Roman Emperor
quote: The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.

title: King of Persia
quote: I am Cyrus, king of the world.

title: Queen of England
quote: I know I have the body of a weak and feeble woman, but I have the heart and stomach of a king, and of a king of England too.

title: Sultan of Egypt and Syria
quote: I warn you against shedding blood, indulging in it and making a habit of it, for blood never sleeps.
note: Recorded by his biographer Baha ad-Din.

title: Ottoman Sultan
quote: What people call empire is nothing but worldly strife and worldwide war.
note: From his own poetry, written under the pen name Muhibbi.

title: Athenian General
quote: Strike, but hear me.
note: To Eurybiades before Salamis, per Plutarch.

title: King of Sparta
quote: Come and take them.
note: Molon labe, attributed per Plutarch's Sayings of Spartans.

title: Athenian Statesman
quote: The bravest are surely those who have the clearest vision of what is before them, glory and danger alike, and yet notwithstanding, go out to meet it.

title: Chancellor of Germany
quote: Politics is the art of the possible.

title: Chancellor of Germany
quote: Not by speeches and majority resolutions are the great questions of the time decided, but by iron and blood.

title: U.S. Army General
quote: I have never advocated war except as a means of peace.

title: U.S. Army General
quote: Find out where your enemy is. Get at him as soon as you can. Strike him as hard as you can, and keep moving on.

title: U.S. Army General
quote: In preparing for battle I have always found that plans are useless, but planning is indispensable.

title: U.S. Army General
quote: Pessimism never won any battle.

title: U.S. Army General
quote: In war, there is no substitute for victory.

title: U.S. Army General
quote: Old soldiers never die; they just fade away.

title: Tsar of Russia
quote: I have conquered an empire but I have not been able to conquer myself.

title: Empress of Russia
quote: I shall be an autocrat: that's my trade. And the good Lord will forgive me: that's his.

title: Roman Dictator
quote: It is easier to find men who will volunteer to die, than to find those who are willing to endure pain with patience.

title: Author of The Art of War
quote: In the midst of chaos, there is also opportunity.
note: Widely rendered from The Art of War, Ch. 5.

title: Emperor of the French
quote: The battlefield is a scene of constant chaos. The winner will be the one who controls that chaos, both his own and the enemies'.

title: Roman Emperor
quote: How much trouble he avoids who does not look to see what his neighbor says or does.

title: British Prime Minister
quote: If you're going through hell, keep going.

title: U.S. Army General
quote: Do your duty as you see it, and damn the consequences.

title: U.S. Army General
quote: There is no security on this earth; there is only opportunity.
